enunciado: Create a Logger with a private constructor and a static method getInstance() that always returns the same object. Log messages from two different functions and show that they all share the same line counter.
objetivos: Guarantee a single instance with a private constructor
pistas: private constructor Logger() prevents new Logger() from outside.
The instance is created the first time it is requested (lazy initialization).
Compare the references with == to check it is the same one.
